visual.titulo: Why a start-up struggles to borrow
visual.nota: A business plan with forecasts lowers the risk

turnos.t: Sara has fifteen thousand euros saved but needs forty thousand. Why won't the bank just lend her the rest?

Because she's a start-up with no trading record. The bank sees high risk, so it charges higher interest or refuses. Finance is the most common start-up problem, along with established competitors and cash flow.
How can she convince the bank?
With a business plan: objectives, market research, marketing, operations and financial forecasts. It shows she can repay, and it forces her to test the idea.
